worker-01/md0: declined by local disks first because it is a software-RAID array (raid0) and the worker also offers 3 local disk(s) ([vdb vdc vdd]), which a run takes first; set spec.discover.preferLocalDisks to false to take it as well
worker-01/sdb: declined by available because the probe refused it: Stacked (held by [md0]), Busy (the kernel refused an exclusive open: md0 holds it)
worker-01/sdc: declined by available because the probe refused it: Stacked (held by [md0]), Busy (the kernel refused an exclusive open: md0 holds it)
worker-01/dm-0: declined by local disks first because it is a multipath map over iSCSI paths and the worker also offers 3 local disk(s) ([vdb vdc vdd]), which a run takes first; set spec.discover.preferLocalDisks to false to take it as well
worker-01/sdd: declined by available because the probe refused it: Stacked (held by [dm-0]), Busy (the kernel refused an exclusive open: dm-0 holds it)
worker-01/sde: declined by available because the probe refused it: Stacked (held by [dm-0]), Busy (the kernel refused an exclusive open: dm-0 holds it)
